_: AUTHORED. A person typed this; no program writes it. It is an INPUT to
pipeline/runtiming/generate, in the same relation review.json has to gauge matching.
Two things live here, and neither is recreatable by re-running anything:
run_labels     when two runs of one species share a reach and the Pacific Salmon
Explorer's CU names do not say which is which. 100 of 463 names
state their own run ('Skeena Coastal Summers'), and every multi-run
STEELHEAD case is already separable that way, so this is short by
design. Where two DIFFERENT populations overlap - Wannock and Rivers
Inlet chinook on one reach - the CU name is the distinguisher and no
coverage_gaps  waters an angler will look up and find nothing for, with the reason.
Recording a gap is not filling it: the app should say 'no chinook
timing here' rather than draw an empty layer and let the reader

coverage_gaps.reason: No Pacific Salmon Explorer chinook Conservation Unit reaches the Chilliwack/Vedder. The three Lower Fraser chinook CUs - Lower Fraser River (Fall 4-1), Lower Fraser River (Summer 5-2) and Lower Fraser River-Maria Slough (Summer 4-1) - all have southern boundaries at 49.22 N; the Chilliwack River runs at about 49.10 N. Chum, Coho, Pink, Sockeye and Steelhead CUs all cover it.
coverage_gaps.action: surface as a stated gap. Do NOT borrow a neighbouring CU's timing: the Vedder chinook fishery is largely hatchery-origin and its timing is a hatchery release schedule, not the wild Lower Fraser curve.
